data.narrative:
General Biological is a Series A biotech company founded by Abhi Godavarthi and David Sozanski. The company has raised $6.6M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a universe of 3 public comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers in the Biotech & Health sector, including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Only one valuation method proved applicable. The stage-progression approach uses the $6.6M total raised as a proxy base value and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A-to-next-stage advancement, yielding an implied valuation of $13.2M. Peer-median valuation was not feasible due to an insufficient narrow peer set at identical or adjacent stage/tier (fewer than 3 datapoints met filter criteria). Public-comp anchoring could not be executed because General Biological's revenue is not publicly disclosed, preventing application of the 9.2x median EV/Sales multiple observed across the three public biotech comparables.

The triangulated valuation range is $11M to $15M, with a median point of $13M. This estimate carries material uncertainty given reliance on a single method and the absence of direct peer multiples or revenue data. The primary lever for refining this range would be clarification of General Biological's current revenue run-rate and customer traction relative to the private peer cohort.
